title: Meh
text: I’m on my third month and while I get shipping is weird everywhere I’m so underwhelmed. Our first box was a bowl, just a bowl. Second box was their Halloween box, it was on point. Third box was supposed to be a Thanksgiving theme, but we got a back to school themed box. In both boxes we received a bigger chewy treat, two smaller treat bags and squeaky toys. I’ve canceled… just not worth it.
label: neutral
